title: Preallocate composite index part joins
description: Replace composite index component and encoded-column join calls with an exact-capacity helper.

criteria: Composite index component keys no longer call join(Self::composite_index_component_separator())
Composite index encoded column lists no longer call columns.join(",")
Generated component-key and encoded-column bytes remain unchanged
Composite index DML and index-cache regression tests pass

notes: The helper computes total part length plus separators and appends into one String.
It is used for metadata encoded column lists, row composite index value keys, meta-value lookup keys, and scan-prefix component keys.
Index matching, ordering, range bounds, and encoded component bytes are unchanged.
